description: The frozen baseline's calibration run, re-scored from its saved trajectories by scripts/rescore_calibration.py. Supplies the junction entry and turn completion counts of paper Section 3.2, which data/results/baseline_calibration.json does not record.

program.relation: data/scenarios/baseline_program.bt is 27 comment lines followed by data/scenarios/candidates/cand_01.bt byte for byte; the parsed trees are equal. Traces record the candidate's hash because calibration ran before the freeze.

definitions.violated: rho < 0, rho = min over active contracts (src/stl.py)
definitions.entered: C2 not vacuous: the ego was in the conflict zone on at least one tick (as src/evaluate.py)
definitions.reached_P4_settle: P4_settle in the sidecar's phases_reached (the ICR of scripts/calibrate_baseline.py)
definitions.argmin_node: bt_node_type:bt_node_path at the argmin row (as scripts/calibrate_baseline.py)
definitions.rho_values: rounded to 6 decimal places; 999.0 is the vacuity sentinel

checks.check: frozen baseline = comment-only header + candidate, byte for byte
frozen baseline and candidate parse to equal trees
sidecar and Parquet param_hash equal the regenerated hash
recorded parameters equal the regenerated parameters
phases_reached agrees with the trace's phase column on P4_settle
